alignments.note: Construct noun with no article morpheme takes a supplied the (rule 29).
Nomen rectum takes the of relation (rule 19).
Comparative preposition is the clause's predicate and takes the supplied copula (rule 49).
dainty morsels: morsels carries the lexeme (rule 31).
Explicit pronoun takes its own they.
go down: the particle completes the verb's rendering (rule 44).

The supplied into is licensed by this adverbial accusative's case-function (rule 33), and the supplied the determines it (rule 15). Competing reading: innermost as the construct noun's word and parts as the rectum's.
בֶּטֶן rendered by the attributive innermost in the ASV's collapsed rendering of the chain.

review_notes: The chain חַדְרֵי־בָטֶן is rendered 'the innermost parts'; the division between construct and rectum is the one materially open question and is named in the unit notes.
